title: Stopped working after 7days of use
text: Stopped working after 7days of use. Made weird noises but was working well up to the 7th day of use. Worked that morning by dinner was no longer heating.  It ran but food was still frozen.  Do not recommend at all. Returned & purchased another brand for $5 more & was bigger.

product_metadata.title: LATURE 4.2 QT Air Fryer Oven Cooker with Temperature and Time Control Dishwasher Non-stick Basket 6 Cook Presets CE Certified Black (Black-Knob)
features: Healthier：360°hot air circulation around the food instead of oil deep fry to reduce fat by 70-80% without sacrificing food flavor,make food crispy on the outside and tender on the inside!
4.2 QT Capacity: Can provide enough space to cook food for 2-4 family members. And it has a compact design that takes up less space in any kitchen.
6 Presets: 6 preset menus let you cook chicken, pizza, steak, fish, drumstick at the perfect preset time (0-30 Minutes) and temperature (170°F-400°F).
Easy Use and Easy Cleanup：Simply load the fryer basket, set the temp and timer, your food comes out crispy. With nonstick, dishwasher-safe baskets, easily cleanup after cooking.
Safer: 30 mins timer automatically shut off and over heating protection function prevents overcooking,makes it safer to use.
